name: row_type
description: 'flow' (one week x source corridor x destination corridor x event type x pool) or 'week' (one marker per pool per week sent)

name: corridor_id
description: The source corridor (H3 res-7, same as source_cell); 'unknown' only on week markers

name: venue_id
description: Always 'corridor-aggregate': no venue or event crosses (boundary doc 4.1.2)

name: week
description: The Monday (UTC) that starts the week

name: source_cell
description: Flow rows only: H3 res-7 cell where the posters hang

name: destination_cell
description: Flow rows only: H3 res-7 cell of those posters' events

name: scans
description: Flow rows only: scans on posters, each poster-hour floored first, never below 5, rounded down to a multiple of 5

name: flows_in_week
description: Week markers only: flow rows sent for this week and pool

name: computed_at
description: When the run that sent this week read it
